---
name: harry-potter-fan-project
description: Tim's Harry Potter fandom: fan project, collectibles, forum activity, fan meetups, UK HP conference (Oct 2023), HP party (Dec 2023), and planned trips
type: project
---
As of 21 May 2023, Tim is working on a Harry Potter fan project and discussing collaborations. Around 14 May 2023 he talked with a friend who is a Harry Potter fan to brainstorm ideas. Planned topics include characters, spells and magical creatures.

On 14 June 2023 he joined a fantasy literature forum and enjoyed talking about his favorite books. As of 15 June 2023 he has a book collection and MinaLima artwork (MinaLima made the props for the HP films) at home, which he uses as a way to escape reality. He says he will likely visit more HP spots in the future.

Around 9 July 2023 he had a chat/meetup with a Harry Potter fan in California and enjoyed it. He also says reading fantasy books helps him escape and feel free.

On 9 August 2023 he Skyped with that same California HP fan; they talked characters and possible collaboration.

Around early October 2023 (the week before 13 October) Tim attended a Harry Potter conference in the UK. He found it incredible, like a magical family of people sharing the same love of HP; it left him inspired with a new lease of life. He values how fantasy connects him with people worldwide.

Update 8 December 2023: Tim just came back from a Harry Potter party where he met many fellow fans and had a lot of fun. He didn't wear a costume but wore his Gryffindor scarf.

files.john-basketball-endorsements.md:
---
name: john-basketball-endorsements
description: Tim's friend John plays basketball (drafted pro, pro just under a year as of Dec 2023), Nike deal, Gatorade talks, outdoor gear deal Dec 2023, beverage company endorsement Jan 2024, goals, Chicago trip, new gym, team trip Oct 2023, married Sept 2023, won a trophy, mentors younger players (Oct 2023); favorite team Wolves, LeBron fan; surfs; hiking club; cooks; European trip Nov 2023; injured Nov 2023, jogging pain-free Dec 2023; reads personal development; yoga Dec 2023; reading Dune Dec 2023; career-high assists Dec 2023; seminars and youth sports charity work Dec 2023; benefit game Jan 2024; Italy trip Dec 2023, learning Spanish, LOTR/Aragorn fan; recommends Barcelona
type: user
---
Tim chats with John, a high-level basketball player. As of 15 June 2023 John was weighing endorsements (Nike, Under Armour).

Update 16 July 2023: John scored a career-high 40 points the previous week and his team won. He signed a Nike basketball shoe and gear deal, is in talks with Gatorade about a sponsorship, and would still love to work with Under Armour. He got deals through basketball-industry contacts and marketing skills. He has a game in Seattle next month (August 2023) and loves the city (food, seafood, fans). John has surfed for about five years and loves the ocean. Tim is supportive.

Update 9 August 2023: John won a tight, intense game the previous week, scoring the last basket. He says his team is like a family away from home.

Update 11 August 2023: John recently visited Chicago and loved the energy and friendly locals. Background: he grew up watching NBA games with his dad, joined a local league at age 10, played through high school, earned a college scholarship, then was drafted. He keeps lucky basketball shoes that symbolize resilience. Goals: win a championship, and give back; he is teaming up with a local organization helping disadvantaged kids with sports and school.

Update 17 August 2023: John rejoined his teammates on 15 August 2023 after his trip and got a warm welcome. They gave him a signed basketball as a symbol of friendship, which motivates him.

Update 21 August 2023: John found a new gym and built a routine balancing basketball practice with strength training plus rest. He owns the whole Harry Potter film collection and his family gets together often.

Update 26 August 2023: John visited home around 19 August and caught up with family and old friends (high school teammates for four years). He loves discovering new cities and has been to New York City, which he highly recommends.

Update 21 September 2023: John went to a restaurant with new teammates in mid-Sept. The team plans a trip in October 2023, destination undecided; Tim suggested Edinburgh and John liked it. John's goals: better shooting, consistency, more endorsements/brand building, life after basketball (maybe a foundation). Tim advised choosing authentic endorsements aligned with values. John loved "The Alchemist".

Update 2 October 2023: John married his girlfriend around 25 September 2023 in a small, intimate greenhouse ceremony with safety protocols; first dance at a cozy candlelit restaurant. He recently joined a hiking club and some members attended. He collects jerseys; his favorite team is the Wolves and favorite player is LeBron James, whom he has met a few times and seen play live. Tim shared a bookshelf of his favorite fantasy novels (his escape from reality).

Update 13 October 2023: John said his season was intense with tough losses and great wins, and his team won a trophy. He says he needs new shoes after all the games.

Update 17 October 2023: John is now mentoring younger players on his team, which keeps him involved in the game in the off-season. He finds it rewarding; some see him as a mentor and he gives advice on and off the court. He hasn't had much time to read but picked up a book after talking with Tim.

Update 21 October 2023: John wants to visit castles (bucket list), keeps motivational quotes on a whiteboard and a plaque on his desk, and relies on teammates and family for support. He relaxes by cooking and reading; favorite dish is honey garlic chicken with roasted veg, and he offered to mail Tim the recipe.

Update 6 November 2023: John and his wife just left (around 6 Nov) on a short European vacation; Tim recommended visiting castles. John recalled a big comeback win last year, trailing in the 4th quarter. Tim says he is a LeBron fan too (2016 Finals Game 7 block) and owns a basketball signed by his favorite player.

Update 11 November 2023: John and his wife road-tripped the European coastline and loved the views. He just finished a fantasy series with many twists and enjoys fantasy as a mental escape; he values taking breaks and balance.

Update 16 November 2023: John has an injury this week (doctor says not too serious); he is staying positive but hates being off the court. He stays motivated by visualizing goals and success.

Update 21 November 2023: John is still recovering, taking it slow and staying positive. He shared past challenges: hurt his ankle last season (time off, physical therapy, learned patience) and once messed up in a big game and learned to own mistakes. He likes non-fiction personal development/mindset books and recently reread "The Alchemist".

Update 1 December 2023: John has started yoga for strength, flexibility, focus and balance; he likes Warrior II and a balance pose, holding for 30-60 seconds. He loves The Hobbit and other popular fantasy series. He camped in the Rocky Mountains last year and shared a photo of a forest near his hometown.

Update 6 December 2023: John has played professionally for just under a year; says it's been great (on-court improvement, endorsement deals, learning to market himself and build his brand). His teammates come from all over the world. His advice for motivating teammates: show care, celebrate achievements, give constructive feedback, remind them of the bigger goal, positive environment, pre-game pep talks.

Update 8 December 2023: John's team recently beat a top team in a tough game. The team keeps its bond with team dinners, outings and games. He is reading "Dune" by Frank Herbert. He hasn't read George R. R. Martin but may try. He mentioned attending a charity event with Harry Potter trivia in August 2023.

Update 11 December 2023: John had a career-high in assists on Friday 8 December 2023 in a big game against a rival. His favorite career moment: down 10 in the 4th, he hit a buzzer-beater to win. As a kid he practiced outside for hours, dreaming of big games, as a way to cope with doubts and stress.

Update 16 December 2023: John's team won a close game the previous week. His injury kept him out of some games; he does daily physical therapy and rehab. On Friday 15 December 2023 he jogged pain-free at the gym for the first time, a milestone; he and his wife hosted a small get-together with friends and family to celebrate.

Update 19 December 2023: Around 12 December 2023 John landed a deal with a renowned outdoor gear company (hiking and outdoor gear) and did a photoshoot in a forest. He found a scenic rocky river spot while hiking and loves nature. His team is growing, especially in communication and bonding, after a good scrimmage the previous week.

Update 26 December 2023: John started giving seminars (week of ~20 Dec 2023) helping aspiring pros with sports and marketing; they went well. He works on supporting youth sports and fair chances for underserved communities, and organized a basketball camp for kids in his hometown in summer 2023. He shared a photo of himself speaking at a charity event. He is a Harry Potter fan and likes movies.

Update 2 January 2024: John visited Italy in Dec 2023 (loved food, history, architecture; bought a book that inspires his cooking). He knows a bit of German and is just starting Spanish using a language app. He practices and trains basketball daily. Favorite fantasy movie: Lord of the Rings; favorite character Aragorn (leader, selfless); he has an Aragorn painting in his room. He has been to Paris and loved it.

Update 7 January 2024: John held a benefit basketball game around 1 Jan 2024 (the week before); it was a big success with a large turnout and money raised for charity. He may visit Ireland (Cliffs of Moher) after his season and will tell Tim. He plans to read "The Name of the Wind" (on his list since Aug 2023).

Update 12 January 2024: John signed an endorsement with a popular beverage company in the week of ~5 Jan 2024 (a dream come true, validation of his hard work). He recommended Barcelona to Tim (culture, architecture, food, beaches).
files.fantasy-writing-gig.md:
---
name: fantasy-writing-gig
description: Tim writes fantasy novel articles for an online magazine (found via fantasy lit forum); favorites Harry Potter, Game of Thrones, Patrick Rothfuss; book conference Sept 2023; writing own fantasy novel (Oct 2023), plot twist block (Nov 2023), UK story setback (Nov 2023); finished A Dance with Dragons (Dec 2023)
type: project
---
As of 2 August 2023, Tim is writing articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine. He found the opportunity on the fantasy literature forum he joined in June 2023, pitched ideas, and the magazine liked them. He finds it very rewarding. Articles cover character studies, themes, and book recommendations. Favorite books to write about: Harry Potter and Game of Thrones.

On 9 August 2023 he was reading a book by Patrick Rothfuss and recommended it to John. On 11 August 2023 he named it as "The Name of the Wind" (praising world-building and character development), and John added it to his reading list. Tim also shared his latest article with John and said he is writing more.

On 17 August 2023 Tim said he hopes to attend a book conference next month (September 2023) with authors, publishers and book lovers, to learn more about literature. He has no other big events planned. He also said a event he attended in July 2023 was one of his favorite experiences of belonging, with everyone sharing the same love for it.

Update 21 October 2023: Tim is in the middle of writing his own fantasy novel (nerve-wracking but exciting, hard work paying off). Inspirations: books, movies, real-life experiences; he recently read a book about UK castles that gave him ideas and he dreams of visiting them. J.K. Rowling is his main author inspiration; he takes notes on her style and has read her for a long time. Favorite quote: "Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times."

Update 6 November 2023: In the last week of October he got stuck on a plot twist in his novel, was very frustrated, but pushed through and got ideas flowing again.

Update 21 November 2023: Last week (about 14 November) Tim had a setback trying to write a story based on his UK trip experiences; it didn't go as he wanted. He asked John for storytelling advice (John suggested reflecting on what went wrong and improving). Harry Potter and GoT are still his favorites.

Update 8 December 2023: Tim just finished "A Dance with Dragons" and recommends it; he has read only the GoT series by George R. R. Martin. He is also reading a series about friendship and loyalty.

---
name: tim-personal-life
description: Tim's current life details: study abroad in Galway, Ireland (Feb 2024), researching visa requirements (Jan 2024), Barcelona on wishlist, school stress, exams, English lit class (Dec 2023), study method, piano and violin learning, learning German (Jan 2024), travel club (Dec 2023), travel planning/agency visit (Dec 2023), family traditions, favorite movies (LOTR, Star Wars), HP Christmas tree, travel wishlist (NYC, Italy), UK castle visit Nov 2023, summer job rejection, Universal Studios trip Sept 2023, Smoky Mountains trip, hobbies, tough exam Nov 2023, bookshelf
type: user

As of 21 August 2023, Tim is focusing on school and reading lots of fantasy books as a break from stress. He recently started learning piano (a learning curve, but satisfying). His favorite piece to play is the theme from "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone", the first HP movie, which he watched with his family (snacks and blankets) and which brings back great memories.

Family time matters a lot to him. Thanksgiving tradition: preparing the feast together, sharing what they're thankful for, then watching movies (Home Alone, Elf, The Santa Clause). He decorated a Harry Potter themed Christmas tree himself and was very happy with it.

Update 26 August 2023: Tim's week was very busy with assignments and exams; he is trying to balance studying with his fantasy reading hobby. He has never been on a sports team (prefers reading and fantasy novels). He likes traveling to new places to experience a different kind of magic. He added New York City to his travel list after John recommended it, and will tell John when he plans to go (John offered to help).

Update 31 August 2023: Tim got a rejection for a summer job he wanted but is staying positive. On 30 August 2023 he gave a class presentation despite nerves and sees it as progress. He is planning his first trip to Universal Studios in September 2023, mainly excited for the Harry Potter attractions; he will report back to John. He likes experimenting with spices/cooking.

Update 17 October 2023: Tim visited the Smoky Mountains in summer 2023 (photo he shared; he said "last year" in conversation but called it last summer) and finds nature refreshing, a break from school. School is going well, busy but balanced with reading books.

Update 21 October 2023: Tim loves road trips with friends and family, hiking, board games, and curling up with a book. He dreams of visiting UK castles. He asked John for his honey garlic chicken recipe (John will mail it) and plans to try it.

Update 16 November 2023: Tim went on a trip to the UK and visited a castle on Friday 10 November 2023; he found the architecture and history amazing (fulfilling his UK castles wish). He was swamped with exams that week. Study method: Pomodoro-style, 25 minutes on then 5 minutes off for something fun.

Update 1 December 2023: Tim had a tough exam in late November 2023 that made him doubt himself, but he studied hard and succeeded, and sees it as proof of his resilience. He recently reorganized his bookshelf (favorites include The Hobbit-type fantasy). He loves nature as a reset for the soul.

Update 6 December 2023: Tim joined a travel club (interested in different cultures and countries, wants to meet new people). He is also learning the violin (mostly into classical, wants to try jazz and film scores), in addition to piano which he has played about four months. Still working on studies.

Update 11 December 2023: Tim did an analysis of a book series for his English lit class and thinks it went ok, though he described the class as tough.

Update 26 December 2023: Tim is planning his next dream trip: he is reading a book of travelers' stories (e.g., two hikers trekking the Himalayas) and visited a travel agency to learn the requirements. He has movie marathons with friends; Lord of the Rings is his favorite fantasy movie. He is excited for the "The Wheel of Time" TV series (said to be coming out next month, Jan 2024), based on a book series he loves. He is a big fan of Emma Watson and admires her gender equality advocacy.

Update 2 January 2024: Tim joined a group of globetrotters (likely the travel club) and enjoys hearing about their trips. Italy is on his travel list (John went in Dec 2023); he also mentioned loving Paris/Eiffel Tower and wants to see it. He is learning German (tough but worthwhile, likes its structure; took French in high school) using a language app. He also named Star Wars as his favorite fantasy movie, alongside LOTR; Harry Potter is his favorite book. He owns a Middle-earth map.

Update 7 January 2024: On Friday 5 January 2024 Tim got accepted into a study abroad program. He goes to Galway, Ireland in February 2024 for a semester (drawn by its arts, Irish music, vibrant atmosphere, and nature). He wants to visit the Cliffs of Moher; John might visit after his season.

Update 12 January 2024: Tim is researching visa requirements for places he wants to visit (overwhelming but exciting; proud of taking initiative). John recommended Barcelona and Tim added it to his travel list.
